text_block_list.text:
Everyone fell silent. Because they all 
knew how high the stakes were.

—The Kikuka Sho. The strange phenomena 
finally begin to subside... Today, 
Manhattan Cafe's true, unadorned strength 
will be put to the test.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is my first time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
For the first time before a race... I had 
a feeling that I might be able to catch up 
to my "friend"...

A rare, carefree smile. Believing this 
race would truly be the light at the end 
of the long tunnel, I chose to watch over 
her.
